hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Northern South America, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Suriname and Venezuela || mostly rolling highlands; low coastal plain; savanna in south || the third-smallest country in South America after Suriname and Uruguay; contains some of the largest unspoiled rainforests on the continent || Resources: bauxite, gold, diamonds, hardwood timber, shrimp, fish || Exports: crude petroleum, railway cargo containers, gold, ships, rice (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly rolling highlands; low coastal plain; savanna in south || Northern South America, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Suriname and Venezuela

climate.excerpt: tropical; hot, humid, moderated by northeast trade winds; two rainy seasons (May to August, November to January) || flash flood threat during rainy seasons

economy.excerpt: small, hydrocarbon-driven South American export economy; major forest coverage being leveraged in carbon credit offsets to encourage preservation; strengthening financial sector; large bauxite and gold resources || Exports: crude petroleum, railway cargo containers, gold, ships, rice (2023) || Industries: bauxite, sugar, rice milling, timber, textiles, gold mining

peopleAndCulture.excerpt: English (official), Guyanese Creole, Amerindian languages (including Caribbean and Arawak languages), Indian languages (including Caribbean Hindustani, a dialect of Hindi), Chinese (2014 est.) || Protestant 34.8% (Pentecostal 22.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 5.4%, Anglican 5.2%, Methodist 1.4%), Hindu 24.8%, other Christian 20.8%, Roman Catholic 7.1%, Muslim 6.8%, Jehovah's Witness 1.3%, Rastafarian 0.5%, other 0.9%, none 3.1% (2012 est.) || East Indian 39.8%, African descent 29.3%, mixed 19.9%, Indigenous 10.5%, other 0.5% (includes Portuguese, Chinese, White) (2012 est.)
